window_object_origin.position_fields_note: Two independent position field pairs exist; both are SetRect'ed in the base window ctor 0x00423B30 but serve different consumers.

resource_visual_inspection.source: Direct pixel inspection of original Data/GameInter.wil Frame 200 (256×512 WIL source; visible UI is clipped to the constructor window).
observations: The artwork contains a vertical character/status panel with empty equipment-slot silhouettes; the slot labels are not baked into Frame 200.
The visible slot artwork must therefore be combined with runtime item graphics and the 11-record paint loop; a static screenshot of Frame 200 alone cannot name the equipment positions.
The close control and the secondary status control are separate child resources (161/162 and 171/172), not part of the slot-record loop.
Frame 171 is a small right-pointing green/gold arrow control; Frame 172 is empty in the current export, so the pair's action name remains unresolved.

Frame 200 also contains no baked-in attribute label artwork (pixel scan found no text-like columns); all attribute labels are drawn at runtime by 0x0044BC80 with GBK strings from .rdata (0x0047C638..0x0047C74C).
